name: Tiger Mastery

narrative.details:
When I was but a young girl, my father trained me in the art of tiger hunting.

You'll find the young felines much easier to track and slay.  For this reason, we'll start you out easy.  One can often find young tigers near the expedition camp.

Test your tracking skills and see if you can hunt some of the beasts down.
narrative.objectives: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Stranglethorn Tigers.
narrative.offerRewardText: Nicely done, adventurer.  You are ready to move on.
narrative.requestItemsText: I don't feel confident in training you further, adventurer, until you have proven yourself skilled in slaying the youngest of the tigers first.
